Instructions for Use
Device description: The Nova Embolization Coil System is a embolization coil. It is available in lengths from 15 mm to 38 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MR Safety
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Nova Embolization Coil System is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
• Static magnetic field of 1.5T and 3.0T
• Maximum MR system reported, whole body averaged specific absorption rate (SAR) of 0.4 W/kg
• Scan regions: Head Only
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Nova Embolization Coil System is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 3.0 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
Patients may be scanned immediately after implantation.
